bugs.title: Shadow Clone creation silently stalls mid-copy — likely Worker execution timeout, resulting repo has only .clipforge-sync.json
bugs.notes: FIXED AND VERIFIED END-TO-END AGAINST THE LIVE GITHUB API. Root cause confirmed by direct code read: createPrivateShadowClone performed the entire bulk copy inside one Worker request (~300 files x 2 fully-awaited GitHub API calls each + tree/commit/PATCH), exceeding the Cloudflare Workers execution budget — the Worker was killed mid-loop after the self-contained bootstrap commit, exactly producing the 'only .clipforge-sync.json' symptom and the stuck 'Preparing repository...' progress. FIX: the bootstrap commit now also ships a one-time clone-copy.yml into the new repo (second Contents PUT on the bootstrap branch, alongside the sync marker); the Worker dispatches it (with retry on the new-workflow 404 indexing lag) and polls .clipforge-clone-status.json every 2s (start/stall/deadline watchdogs at 120s/360s/600s) — the same commit-a-status-file + bot-polls pattern as the job pipeline. The workflow copies the cloneable tree locally from a --filter=blob:none partial clone of the (public) source, pushes it as ONE fast-forward commit chain, and the bot then copies the source's own 8 workflow files + deletes the one-time workflow via the Contents API with the user's PAT. Three failure modes found and fixed ONLY through live end-to-end runs: (1) a bare 'while read' loop executes zero iterations under Actions' closed stdin (COPIED: 0 caught by the verify step) — file list now redirected via '<'; (2) pushes from GITHUB_TOKEN touching .github/workflows/* are remote-rejected AND Contents-API PUTs for workflow files are 403 — the push therefore contains no workflow paths and workflow files go through the bot's PAT (the same authority the original in-Worker copy used; onboarding already requires the workflow scope); (3) ~330 paced REST blob writes tripped GitHub's secondary rate limit (403 after minutes of retries) — eliminated by the single-push design. Also fixed: mawk cannot parse escaped slashes in awk regex constants (modes manifest uses substr/index instead); exec bits restored via chmod from an ls-tree modes manifest (the source ships one 100755 script); printf '\n' inside the JS template literal must be written '\\n' or the emitted YAML breaks. bug-46 bootstrap-first + bug-47 default-branch normalization logic preserved untouched; post-conditions still verify the default branch head and blob count against the live API (floor adjusted: the workflow push verifies >= TOTAL-WFCOUNT server-side, the bot verifies >= TOTAL after the PAT workflow writes land). Live verification: fresh repo clipforge-test-bug63-0iluoi created by the real createPrivateShadowClone() — 303 blobs on main (302 source files incl. all 8 workflows + sync marker), one-time workflow removed, bot/src/github.js byte-identical to the source blob, live progress streamed (copy 50..294/294, finalize), ~63s total, test repo deleted (404 confirmed). Bot test suite 110/110 pass.

bugs.title: Remove manual 'push update to clones' trigger — updates to clones must be fully automatic
bugs.notes: Design reversal: remove manual 'Push update to clones' button from Settings; on every push to main on the main account, automatically propagate the update to all connected clones reusing the existing sync/copy logic; preserve the changelog/notification-to-clone-owner behavior; preserve owner-identity gating (main vs clone) for source-of-truth determination.
